selection: all two fixed cells; no neighborhood, optimization or winner selection
claim: spent historical development only; no profitable, untouched OOS or deployment claim
future_confirmation: If any screen passes, register a separate future-only candidate with adequate power and execution calibration before evaluating post-freeze observations. No automatic orders.

definitions.RSI2: SMA200(close) below close AND Wilder RSI2<=10 enter; close>SMA5(close) exit
definitions.CCICorrectionStrategy: CCI200>100 AND CCI5<-100 enter; CCI200<-100 AND CCI5>100 exit
definitions.CCI: (typical price - SMA(typical price))/(0.015 times mean absolute deviation); zero deviation gives0
definitions.RSI: Wilder gain/loss averages, SMAseed first2 differences; no losses gives100, fullyflat gives0
